Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 9a9f1d1a81a972513636c333e26c542f8aebae55 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Date: Tue, 5 Mar 2019 12:36:33 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] fbdev: mbx: fix a misspelled variable name

A recent cleanup introduced a build failure when a variable
was spelled incorrectly:

In file included from drivers/video/fbdev/mbx/mbxfb.c:881:
drivers/video/fbdev/mbx/mbxdebugfs.c: In function 'mbxfb_debugfs_init':
drivers/video/fbdev/mbx/mbxdebugfs.c:217:2: error: 'mbfi' undeclared (first use in this function); did you mean 'mfbi'?
  mbfi->debugfs_dir = dir;
  ^~~~
  mfbi
drivers/video/fbdev/mbx/mbxdebugfs.c:217:2: note: each undeclared identifier is reported only once for each function it appears in
drivers/video/fbdev/mbx/mbxdebugfs.c:213:21: error: unused variable 'mfbi' [-Werror=unused-variable]
  struct mbxfb_info *mfbi = fbi->par;
                     ^~~~

Fixes: 72aed9e31344 ("fbdev: mbx: fix up debugfs file creation")
Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Cc: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>
Signed-off-by: Bartlomiej Zolnierkiewicz <b.zolnierkie@samsung.com>

diff --git a/drivers/video/fbdev/mbx/mbxdebugfs.c b/drivers/video/fbdev/mbx/mbxdebugfs.c
index 52cfe0132b25..09af721638fb 100644
--- a/drivers/video/fbdev/mbx/mbxdebugfs.c
+++ b/drivers/video/fbdev/mbx/mbxdebugfs.c
@@ -214,7 +214,7 @@ static void mbxfb_debugfs_init(struct fb_info *fbi)
 	struct dentry *dir;
 
 	dir = debugfs_create_dir("mbxfb", NULL);
-	mbfi->debugfs_dir = dir;
+	mfbi->debugfs_dir = dir;
 
 	debugfs_create_file("sysconf", 0444, dir, fbi, &sysconf_fops);
 	debugfs_create_file("clock", 0444, dir, fbi, &clock_fops);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/video/fbdev/mbx/mbxdebugfs.c`**
   - **Line Change**: The variable `mbfi` was incorrectly used in the line `mbfi->debugfs_dir = dir;`. It has been corrected to `mfbi->debugfs_dir = dir;`.
   - **Context**: This change is made within the function `mbxfb_debugfs_init`, which initializes the debug filesystem for the framebuffer device.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a build failure caused by a recent cleanup that introduced a misspelled variable name. The incorrect usage of `mbfi` instead of the correctly defined `mfbi` led to an undeclared identifier error. By correcting the variable name, the patch resolves the build issue and ensures that the debug filesystem directory is properly assigned to the correct structure member. This fix is directly related to a previous commit that aimed to improve the debug filesystem file creation, indicating that the changes are part of an ongoing effort to enhance the code's reliability and maintainability.
